items.title: Liberals considering ban on some foreign citizens under tougher immigration stance
items.description: Angus Taylor says he will unite the Liberal Party, but a deeper rift is forming between those who want to overhaul the party's direction and those who believe doing so would mean political death.

items.title: Why a packet of Arnott's Shapes could help determine the 'case of the century'
items.description: The "case of the century" is set to play out in the federal court this month, with the ACCC taking on supermarket giant Coles for what it claims are "illusory" discounts.

items.title: AI got personal last week, and it's more complicated than we think
items.description: A fake news story about me, a series of AI breakthroughs, and a resignation in the tech world have shown that 2026 could be pivotal for AI.

items.title: Cousin of Bondi Junction attack victim calls out stabber's misogyny
items.description: A bereaved family member of victim Jade Young feels many of his questions surrounding the deadly attack and its aftermath have been left unanswered from the inquest.

items.title: Record spike in whooping cough cases due to 'potentially catastrophic' trend
items.description: A "potentially catastrophic" decline in Australia's childhood vaccination rates has contributed to the sharpest increase in cases of whooping cough in 35 years, infectious diseases experts say.

items.title: Live: Crash costs Australia in snowboard cross final after Graham's battling bronze

items.title: As high-speed rail plans gather pace, Britain's HS2 offers hard lessons

items.title: Ukrainian drone strikes Russian Black Sea oil port
items.description: Two people were wounded in the attack on the port of Taman in the Krasnodar region, ahead of US-brokered peace talks between Ukraine and Russia.

items.title: How queer communities are finding strength in sport after hate

items.title: Ex-Box Hill North captain disappointed by 'lenient' sanctions over costumes

items.title: Port Jackson sharks fall prey to algal bloom, SA ecologists fear

items.title: Six mysterious 'Twin Peaks' deaths in Balkan Mountains stir controversy

items.title: 'Third time lucky': de Minaur breaks through for Rotterdam Open triumph

items.title: Anthony Kim's journey to hell and back leads him to LIV glory in Adelaide
items.description: American Anthony Kim, who has overcome alcohol and drug addiction, hopes his emotional win at LIV Golf's Adelaide tournament will inspire others.

items.title: Last man standing: When Steven Bradbury shocked the world

items.title: Women's advocate quits Liberal Party after Ley defeat

items.title: Taylor lays battle lines on capital gains tax as deputy defends nuclear policy

items.title: Obama deplores lack of shame after Trump shares monkey clip

items.title: India and Pakistan refuse handshakes in contentious T20 World Cup clash

items.title: Australia falls to defeat against India in opening T20 of multi-format series

items.title: 'I am shocked': Unpacking One Nation's spectacular rise in the polls

items.title: Frog toxins the latest poison identified in long line of Russian chemical attacks

items.title: New Zealand's North Island braces for more rain amid widespread flooding
items.description: Floods cause power outages, road collapses, home evacuations and are linked to the death of a man whose vehicle was submerged on a highway.
